fixed.summary: The time on the order in production is held to its tile: a box narrowed by the figure's length (four characters take the tile) is its size container, so a long time (10:00:00) stays whole on the tile at any text scale instead of being cut.
The wave's title is never cut: it fits, or wraps onto a second line (WAVE 7 · SIEGE on a phone at 150 % text).
The selected units' cards lie on one row while they all fit, else in two even rows (twelve as six and six), never a full row and a short orphaned one.
